Ava T: Quick note — DAST acceptance jobs started failing in staging with KMS error when we tried to spin ephemeral keys for scan credentials.

Sam K: error? paste logs

Ava T: staging-dast-22: KMSError: key not found projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/test-ring/cryptoKeys/ephemeral-scan-key

Ravi N: did the key creation step run? we create ephemeral keys with a short TTL via terraform + cloud build.

Leah M: we switched to a new automation that uses service per-scan keys (ephemeral). If the key creation race fails, the DAST runner tries to use a cached token which we recently disabled.

Ava T: reproducer: run cloudbuild step 'create-key' then immediately start scan; it fails intermittently. Suspect eventual consistency in KMS IAM or propagation delay.

sec-bot: Audit log: 2026-04-05T11:02:13Z cloudbuild.run by user:sam.k@redwood.com — created key: ephemeral-scan-key (build/1877)

dast-bot: DAST job 22 failed: exit-code 2 — no credentials

Sam K: workaround: add a retry + backoff after key creation before binding IAM. Also consider creating the key with binding in the same transaction using the key policy.

Ravi N: adding retries helps but we should avoid too-long delays. Proposal: create key + initial IAM binding in cloudbuild, then pass the key resource name to the runner. Also make the runner tolerant: if key not found error, wait up to 30s with exponential backoff. 

Leah M: for prod we cannot rely on long waits. Alternative: use a short-lived KMS-encrypted secret stored in Secret Manager and grant the runner access to decrypt via a stable SA — then rotate the secret per-scan. That reduces key churn and IAM propagation cost.

Ava T: runbook gap: no premerge check to verify cloudbuild steps that create keys include the iam binding. We need a checklist + a unit test that mocks IAM propagation.

Sam K: I'll open SEC ticket SEC-2026-210 for triage and mitigation. Attach logs + cloudbuild YAML + the failing build ID.

sec-bot: Ticket SEC-2026-210 created. Labels: dast, kms, flaky

Ravi N: immediate unblock: reverted the runner change that disabled cache fallback. That let jobs continue while we fix automation.

Leah M: follow-ups: 1) add key-creation backoff + idempotent binding 2) add integration test that runs cloudbuild key creation against a staging project 3) add alert if >3 ephemeral key creations fail in 24h 4) document approvers for ephemeral key flow in /docs/security/dast-kms-ephemeral.md

Ava T: also add a small dashboard in Redwood Console to show key creation latency for ephemeral workflows — helps Optimize assess cost/latency tradeoffs.

Sam K: PR incoming for cloudbuild changes and a small e2e test. Will reference SEC-2026-210 in PR description.

Ava T: thanks — saved the postmortem notes here. :memo:

sec-bot: Audit snapshot attached to SEC-2026-210
